{{Quote|Pleasant little things, huh?|[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="SS" />}}
'''Ithorian crawlers''' were genetically designed organisms capable of surviving in a zero-moisture environment. These beings were seeded on the planet [[Gholondreine-β]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after it [[Desiccation of Gholondreine-β|drained]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. According to the Empire's intention, the Ithorian crawlers exuded a long-lasting [[Poison/Legends|biotoxin]] into the soil of Gholondreine-β, making the planet completely uninhabitable for many [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|They're not even good to eat. Taste like recycled flange oil.|Bossk, to Boba Fett|<ref name="SS" />}}
The crawlers were laboratory-created [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrids]] derived from an [[Ithorian root-source]], genetically engineered for survival in zero-moisture environments. These [[Lung/Legends|many-legged]] [[Insect/Legends|insectoids]] reached nearly one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] in length and bore a resemblance to [[Centipede/Legends|centipedes]] in form. The final broods possessed needle-fanged [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]], enabling them to burrow through soft, crumbling stone and cluster in dense, hissing nests. During burrowing, they exuded [[Poison/Legends|bio-toxins]] into the surrounding soil with a molecular breakdown rate measurable in [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]. Nevertheless, high concentrations of this same toxin could prove [[Death/Legends|fatal]] to them. A greenish-black ichor flowed within their bodies, the taste of which resembled recycled flange [[Oil/Legends|oil]].<ref name="SS" />

==History==
===A weapon of the Empire’s vindictiveness===
{{Quote|Standard operating procedure for the Empire. Especially when the Emperor's in his punitive mode.|Boba Fett, to Bossk|<ref name="SS" />}}
[[File:Gholondreine.jpg|left|thumb|270px|The Galactic Empire seeded the crawlers on Gholondreine-β to exude a long-lasting biotoxin into the soil]]
In [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], a number of [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]] from the planet [[Gholondreine-β]] began publishing urgent and scathing critiques of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]'s rule.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="EU" /> As punishment, Palpatine ordered all the planet's [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Desiccation of Gholondreine-β|drained]] to the last molecule<ref name="SS" /><ref name="TEA" /> and forced most [[Gholondreine|residents]] to flee the dying world.<ref name="CE" /> But that brutal retribution did not seem sufficiently exemplary to the Emperor;<ref name="SS" /> then the [[Desert/Legends|arid desert]] wasteland<ref name="CE" /> into which the desiccated Gholondreine-β had been transformed was seeded with Ithorian crawlers.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="EU" /> These creatures were laboratory [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrids]], genetically designed to exist in a zero-moisture environment,<ref name="SS" /> and were intended to exude a long-lasting [[Poison/Legends|biotoxin]] into the soil<ref name="TEA" /> at a molecular breakdown rate measurable in [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]. Eventually, the toxin levels would rise high enough to kill the creatures themselves. By then, however, the entire surface crust of the planet would be riddled with their poison-filled boreholes.<ref name="SS" />

===The sole inhabitants of Gholondreine-β===
{{Quote|What good are they?''"<br />"''They're not any «good» at all.|Bossk and Boba Fett|<ref name="SS" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the two [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] agreed to meet on the dead world of Gholondreine-β,<ref name="SS" /><ref name="AS">''[[Aurra Sing: Dawn of the Bounty Hunters]]''</ref><ref name="CE" /> deep within a dried marine trench. Bossk arrived first and encountered Ithorian crawlers, which he took for native inhabitants. Guided by the philosophy of [[Trandoshan/Legends|his people]], he took an «exploratory bite» of one of the centipede-like creatures. Shortly afterward, he felt slightly ill, which he blamed on the crawler's nature.<ref name="SS" />

[[File:Bossk.png|right|thumb|270px|Bossk was irritated at the thought that anyone would deliberately concoct an unpalatable life-form such as an Ithorian crawler]]
When Boba Fett appeared, he scanned the area and detected numerous organic life-forms within the surrounding cliffs, which immediately struck him as suspicious. Bossk, already familiar with the crawlers, fired his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] into the cliff directly above where he and Fett stood. Then, using the toe of his boot, he sifted through the dry rubble. From it, he pulled a writhing, centipede-like creature that lashed itself around his ankle with ferocious malice. Before it could sink its fangs into his shin, he snapped the creature in two with the butt of his rifle. The dead creature had left a black smear on Bossk's boot. He bent down and wiped it off with his thumb-claw.<ref name="SS" />

Boba Fett raised the gaze of his dark-visored helmet toward the cliff face. What had seemed still and lifeless moments before now shimmered in the harsh sunlight with intertwining motion, like maggots in rotting flesh. The blaster shot had roused entire nests of the many-legged creatures, which began pouring from holes bored into the stone. The sonic impact had also startled the creatures on the far side of the trench. For a moment, the walls on either side of Bossk and Boba Fett writhed with coiling insectoid forms and glinting hungry yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="SS" />

Fett revealed to Bossk the origin of these creatures, but he felt only irritation at the thought that anyone would deliberately create such an unpalatable life-form.<ref name="SS" />
